optAutoModeExt: The brain of PingPimp. Automatically monitors foreground apps and bandwidth usage to shift kernel priorities (TCP, MTU, IRQ, etc.) on the fly without user intervention.
tabConfigDesc0: Automatically detect apps and adjust network preset dynamically.
tabConfigDesc1: Set the preset tweak according to your needs and select the TCP algorithm you want.
optPresetExt: PingPimp provides several aggressive kernel configuration profiles. 'Game' prioritizes packet delivery instantly, while 'Download' maximizes TCP window sizing for huge throughput. Let Smart Auto Mode decide for you.
optTcpExt: Congestion control dictates how your device handles network traffic. BBR is phenomenal for bandwidth, while Westwood or Cubic handles lossy Wi-Fi (gaming) much better.
tabConfigDesc2: Secure your DNS queries with encrypted DNS providers. Choose a trusted resolver below.
optDnsExt: Encrypts your Domain Name System requests to prevent ISPs from tracking your browsing history. Also helps bypass local internet censorship.
optNicExt: Hardware batching improves bandwidth but adds slight processing delay. Disabling it forces real-time packet processing—ideal for lowering ping spikes in competitive games.
tabConfigDesc6: Disable GRO/GSO to bypass batching and reduce latency.
optIrqExt: By default, Android spreads network interrupts across all CPU cores. Pinning it forces only the high-performance cores to handle Wi-Fi/Data traffic, avoiding stutters.
tabConfigDesc7: Pin network interrupts to performance cores.
optLowatExt: Prevents bufferbloat inside the socket queue. By keeping the queue extremely short, your game packets won't get stuck behind a background update.
tabConfigDesc8: Limit socket queues to prevent bufferbloat.
optKsoftExt: Elevates the kernel's software interrupt threads to Real-Time (FIFO) priority. Network traffic will literally bypass the standard CPU scheduler.
tabConfigDesc9: Grant real-time priority to kernel network threads.
tabConfigDesc3: Increase network speed by disabling netstats and optimizing wifi connectivity.
optNetStateExt: Disables Android's built-in background network statistics and Wi-Fi scanning. Stops the system from periodically 'freezing' your ping to search for nearby networks.
tabConfigDesc4: Force IPv4 routing to prevent IPv6 DNS leaks, routing issues, and high latency in games.
optIpv6Ext: Many mobile operators have poorly routed IPv6 infrastructure causing random packet drops. Forcing IPv4 ensures a more stable, mature routing path.
tabConfigDesc5: Restricts background data and limit internet speed to only 1mb/s.
optDataSaverExt: Hard-limits your ingress connection speed and aggressively cuts off background apps from consuming data. Do not use this if you are downloading a large game file.
optSaveLogDesc: Export PingPimp operational log to internal storage.
tabIsolateDesc: Block internet access for specific apps to prevent background data usage and interruptions.
tabBoostDesc: Prioritize network traffic for specific games or apps to reduce latency and ping drops.
